title: Decision: Appointment of the External Auditor
text:
CS-2024-4987(E) distributed 27/11/2024 
*CS-2024-4987.E* 
 
 
OPCW 
Conference of the States Parties 
Twenty-Ninth Session 
25 – 29 November 2024 
 
C-29/DEC.6 
25 November 2024 
Original: ENGLISH 
 
DECISION 
APPOINTMENT OF THE EXTERNAL AUDITOR 
The Conference of the States Parties,  
 
Recalling that, according to Financial Regulation 13.1 of the OPCW Financial Regulations 
and Rules, an External Auditor, who shall be the Auditor-General (or an officer holding an 
equivalent title) of a State Party, shall be appointed in the manner and for the period determined 
by the Conference of the States Parties (the Conference), and for a single period of not less 
than two years, but not exceeding six years; 
 
Recalling also decision C-10/DEC.6 (dated 10 November 2005), in which the Conference 
confirmed that “in no case shall a single audit institution hold the position of External Auditor 
of the OPCW for more than six consecutive years”; 
 
Recalling further that in decision C-10/DEC.6 the Conference also decided that “the period 
of office referred to in Financial Regulation 13.1 may also be made up of an initial term of 
three years, renewable for one subsequent term of up to three years”; 
 
Recalling further decision C-27/DEC.6 (dated 28 November 2022), in which the Conference 
approved the procedure for the manner of appointment of the External Auditor of the OPCW 
as well as the selection criteria for the appointment; 
 
Noting that, by the closing date for nominations, that is 31 March 2024, the Technical 
Secretariat had received nominations for the External Auditor of the OPCW from two States 
Parties; 
 
Noting also the report and recommendation of the Evaluation Panel for the Appointment of 
the External Auditor of the OPCW (EC-107/WP.1, dated 6 September 2024); and 
 
Noting further the decision of the Executive Council at its 107th Session (EC-107/DEC.11, 
dated 10 October 2024) recommending the appointment of Girish Chandra Murmu,  
the Comptroller and Auditor General of India, and Isma Yatun, of the Audit Board of the 
Republic of Indonesia as the External Auditors of the OPCW for the financial years 2024 to 
2026 and 2027 to 2029, respectively; 
 

C-29/DEC.6 
page 2 
 
Hereby: 
 
Appoints: 
 
1. 
Girish Chandra Murmu, the Comptroller and Auditor General of India, as External 
Auditor of the OPCW to audit the OPCW’s financial and administrative operations for 
a subsequent term of three years, for the financial years 2024 to 2026; and 
2. 
Isma Yatun, of the Audit Board of the Republic of Indonesia, as External Auditor of 
the OPCW to audit the OPCW’s financial and administrative operations for an initial 
term of three years, for the financial years 2027 to 2029.
